name: Park Hyatt Sanya Sunny Bay
positioning: Park Hyatt resort on Sunny Bay in Sanya, with ocean-view rooms, courtyard rooms with private gardens and villas with private pools
best_for: Travelers who want rooms with views of Sunny Bay and the South China Sea
Families or groups wanting a two-bedroom villa with a kitchen, private pool and butler service

facts.text: Premium ocean-view rooms look out over Sunny Bay and the South China Sea.
The destination has a year-round tropical climate, verdant mountains, white-sand beaches and coral reefs.
Courtyard rooms have a private outdoor garden, a bay window and a marble bathtub.
The villas have a fully equipped open kitchen and private dining areas inside and outside.
Lake-view villas include an in-room espresso machine, daily minibar refilling and all-day butler service.
Lake-view villas have balconies with views of the lake, garden and lawn.
Suites have a spacious bathroom with a walk-in shower.
The resort has family-friendly items available.

highlights.text: In panoramic ocean-view rooms, perpendicular mirrored glass on one side extends the view of the ocean and Sunny Bay.
The villas have a living room with a Chinese fretwork ceiling.
Garden villas have a courtyard, a private pool and a sun deck, with landscaping that provides complete privacy.
Courtyard ocean-view rooms look onto a coconut grove and the South China Sea.
Panoramic ocean-view rooms are on high floors with windows stretching from one side of the room to the other.

considerations.text: WhataHotel notes the remote location may require transportation for exploring Sanya city center.
WhataHotel notes premium luxury pricing reflecting the high-end positioning.
